entries.title: Stranded: Alien Dawn
entries.definitive_edition: Stranded: Alien Dawn Premium Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Premium Edition or current PC release with Robots and Guardians
primary.why: Stranded: Alien Dawn launched out of Early Access on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox on April 25, 2023. The current public storefront route presents a Premium Edition with the Robots and Guardians DLC, including the Windows PC release and DLC path. No platform-exclusive gameplay was found, so Windows PC with the DLC installed is the best archive route for fidelity, controls, and capture.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC build on Steam/Epic or the current storefront equivalent, ideally through the Premium Edition or with Robots and Guardians installed for the most complete current content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Robots and Guardians is DLC/edition content, not a separate game or remaster.
